description: Controlled, reproducible patches for comparing a green-test baseline with AgentProof.

cases.task: Update greeting(name) so it trims surrounding whitespace and treats a blank name as friend, while preserving the existing greeting format.

baseline_files.greeting.py:
def greeting(name: str) -> str:
    return f"Hello, {name}!"

cases.task: Change normalize_percent(value) so values below 0 become 0 and values above 100 become 100; values already in range must stay unchanged.

baseline_files.percent.py:
def normalize_percent(value: int) -> int:
    return value

candidate_files.percent.py:
def normalize_percent(value: int) -> int:
    return max(0, min(100, value))

cases.task: Improve slugify(text) so it trims outer whitespace and collapses every run of whitespace, including tabs, into one hyphen while returning lowercase text.

baseline_files.slug.py:
def slugify(text: str) -> str:
    return text.lower().replace(" ", "-")

cases.task: Update parse_enabled(value) so the word true is accepted case-insensitively with surrounding whitespace; every other value remains false.

baseline_files.flags.py:
def parse_enabled(value: str) -> bool:
    return value == "true"
baseline_files.tests/test_flags.py:
from flags import parse_enabled


def test_lowercase_values() -> None:
    assert parse_enabled("true") is True
    assert parse_enabled("false") is False

candidate_files.flags.py:
def parse_enabled(value: str) -> bool:
    return value.strip().casefold() == "true"

cases.task: Update total_with_tax(amount) to include the default tax rate from rates.py and round the final amount to two decimal places; zero must remain zero.

baseline_files.pricing.py:

cases.task: Update parse_date(text, default) so an empty input raises ValueError instead of silently returning the default; valid non-empty date strings must retain their existing result.

source.note: Dependency-free behavioral reproduction derived from the public bug report; this is not copied upstream source code.

cases.task: Refactor net_price(price, discount) without changing behavior: its result is exactly price minus discount, including a negative result when discount exceeds price.

baseline_files.pricing.py:
def net_price(price: float, discount: float) -> float:
    return round(price - discount, 2)

cases.task: Refactor multiply(left, right) without changing multiplication behavior.

baseline_files.calculator.py:
def multiply(left: int, right: int) -> int:
    return left * right

candidate_files.calculator.py:
def multiply(left: int, right: int) -> int:
    return left + right

cases.task: Simplify is_even(value) without changing its results for even or odd integers.

baseline_files.parity.py:
def is_even(value: int) -> bool:
    return value % 2 == 0

candidate_files.parity.py:
def is_even(value: int) -> bool:
    return True

cases.task: Refactor divide(left, right) without changing division behavior or its ZeroDivisionError for a zero divisor.

baseline_files.divide.py:
def divide(left: float, right: float) -> float:
    return left / right
baseline_files.tests/test_zero.py:
import pytest
from divide import divide


def test_zero_divisor() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ZeroDivisionError):
        divide(8.0, 0.0)

candidate_files.divide.py:
def divide(left: float, right: float) -> float:
    return left / right if right else 0.0
